claims.text: A toy tile count is Poisson with mean one drop. What is its probability of zero drops? Options: 13.5%; 36.8%; 50%. Toy model: compare two controlled cases.
claims.source: Stipulated numerical case in model.ts, based on manager numericCase: Poissonper-tile rate lambda=.5,1,2; emptytileprobexp(-lambda)=.60653,.367879,.135335; chance>=2=1-exp(-lambda)*(1+lambda). Exactexpectedfrequencies, not randomly handpicked tile counts.

claims.text: A Poisson count has mean 0.5. Chance of zero? P(0)=exp(−0.5)≈0.607.
